character.note: Two-learner contrast named directly in each worked-example (weaker Tom first, then stronger Amara), now as students in the School of Sport. Not token substituted.

_note: School of Sport container context pack for criticality-advanced. This frames the skill for the School of Sport as a whole, drawing worked examples from across its subjects (sport & exercise science, sport coaching, sport therapy and rehabilitation, sport management and development, strength & conditioning). There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark file.
